futureGatesAndObservations: The 32MiB transaction budget is currently checked after reducer staging and serialization of all event/change/inverse values. It is an admission bound, not a demonstrated peak allocation ceiling. Prove protocol aggregate bound or reject incrementally before overstating bounded memory in production.

Persisted inverse rows/control/projection are untrusted. Current rollback does not independently authenticate completeness of inverse rows; later fresh canonical reauthentication must validate the complete coverage/projection and reject missing/extra/trailing rows before visibility.

Empty transaction segments retain cursor advancement and block identity/count but no explicit transaction hash field. Future completeness reconciliation must reconstruct and compare canonical physical enumeration, not treat raw coverage metadata as cryptographic proof.

Volume test checks final RSS and growth between two sampling points, not peak process RSS. If the fixed acceptance target is peak <=512MiB, the separate runner must measure/enforce that target; a 4GiB outer cap plus end samples cannot prove it.
WAL auto-checkpoint/last-close work and generation GC are explicitly unqualified. No production readiness until bounded operational ownership and measurement exist.

Public ranking, Home merge byte/work bounds, directory empty continuation/keyset semantics, privacy route grammar, deep canonical restart/reorg and dense complete wire coverage are separate mandatory work, not inferred from indexes or this storage test.
The existing in-memory factory still has its old lifetime caps. This isolated adapter does not remove production capacity limits yet.
